scope: Bound branch-specific business-report reads before applying source caps; align attendance reconciliation with the selected branch.
changes: Ledger, cash transactions and attendance events use branch equality and the existing Vietnam-day interval before limit.
Branch ledger/cash ranges read newest-first to use descending indexes. Complete aggregates are order-independent; capped aggregates remain explicitly partial.
Attendance reconciliation counts only the selected branch. Previously unrelated and unallocated attendance could appear in a branch warning.
System-wide reads retain their legacy query shape and include unallocated rows. Selected branch ledger/cash already excluded unallocated rows in the old reducer.
No source predicate is pushed: legacy source inference, reversals, cash and recognised revenue remain compatible.
Unallocated payroll inclusion and global cash-account readiness retain their existing policy; these queries remain bounded and shared across scopes.
Cash truncation and possible payroll truncation are exposed. Any reached source cap adds an incomplete-data warning rather than claiming full reconciliation.

indexPlan.plannerObservation: Before the new cash index, scoped cash uses TableScan/MajorSort. Scoped ledger already uses the existing ordered branch/date index. Attendance uses its branch/date index with a within-key MinorSort. Verify cash again after index READY.
indexPlan.measurement: Enterprise ExecutePipeline explain-only diagnostics using a synthetic branch and equivalent Core query shapes; no production query execution or record contents.

validation.largeFixture: 10002 foreign rows in each of ledgerEntries, cashTransactions and attendanceEvents, plus one selected row per source. A branch-manager report returns 3 business documents in total, excluding auth and empty-query minimums. System reports remain capped and explicitly partial.
validation.authorization: Actual trustedAccessContext tested for admin, branch manager, wrong branch, system scope denied to branch manager, disabled, student and missing authentication.
validation.compatibility: Vietnam range endpoints, legacy sources and missing branch IDs, pending/reversed entries, source filters, global payroll fallback and cash-account readiness.

releaseOrder: Coordinate with the separate Academy release; do not overlap Rules or main changes.
Require exact source CI, index scope tests, READY indexes and a post-index planner observation.
Deploy both existing report callable regions together; verify serving images/runtime and transport, then merge and public smoke.
remaining: Large system/branch reports still have source caps; this is not the daily-summary redesign.
Payroll with missing branch retains legacy inclusion and needs a separately reviewed allocation/migration policy.
Historical attendance missing branch is visible in the system report only; this change does not infer or backfill a branch.
No measured production billed-unit, latency or currency saving claim.
